verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV exposes some API actions (create session, retry via /identity_verification/retry, webhooks for status/step updates) that mirror UI functionality, but several core management actions are explicitly UI/Dashboard-only: verification workflows are built with a 'no-code editor' (docs-8) and failed verifications are overridden 'via the Dashboard by clicking the Override Result button' with no documented API equivalent (docs-7), and reporting/risk-factor views are also Dashboard-centric (docs-19, docs-20). No OpenAPI spec was discoverable (probe-3), further limiting confidence in full API/UI parity. missing for 10: API endpoints for workflow template creation/editing, API endpoint for overriding failed verification results, and machine-readable API spec confirming parity.
